primitives.name: BM25 Keyword Search
primitives.verbatim_quote: Keyword ranking is competitive at this size, needs no model weights, no network and no GPU, and is auditable — every ranking shows which terms matched.
primitives.latex: \text{Score}(q, d) \propto \sum_{t \in q} IDF(t) \frac{n_r + k_1 (1 - b + b \frac{|d|}{avgdl}}{k_1 + n_r} \cdot f(t, d)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'IDF(t)': 'Inverse Document Frequency of term t (dimensionless)', 'n_r': 'Number of documents containing term t (dimensionless)', 'k_1': 'Smoothing parameter (typically 2.0) (dimensionless)', 'b': 'Length normalization parameter (typically 0.75) (dimensionless)', 'f(t, d)': 'Term frequency of t in document d (dimensionless)', '|d|': 'Document length in tokens (dimensionless)', 'avgdl': 'Average document length in corpus (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes independent term occurrence, constant average document length, and a static corpus during search.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates when query terms appear in a single document, causing IDF singularity; also fails for very short documents due to division by small |d|.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSI's conformal score calibration, where IDF weights correspond to posterior odds ratios and term frequency maps to likelihood ratios.
layer2.telemetry: Mean average precision (MAP) on held-out queries, measuring how well the keyword match order reflects human relevance judgments.
